status: Available style specification; final outputs require format-specific visual checks
source: Original interpretations of style names demonstrated in a user-supplied video; not recovered source code.
quality_checks: Readable text and measured contrast against rendered colors
No information communicated by color alone
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow
Content remains readable without blur or animation

motion.reduced_motion: Remove decorative movement and nonessential transitions

name: Synthwave
summary: A retro-future horizon with a restrained neon foreground.
use_when: Use for creative technology launches, game-like learning, and campaign heroes.
avoid_when: Use sparingly in dense reading and preserve stable, high-contrast text surfaces.
typography: Bold system sans-serif headings with monospace labels.
layout: Horizon grid and sunset geometry behind a stable foreground.
surfaces: Deep violet, magenta outlines, and a warm stylized sun.

adaptations.web: Use the tokens and live components; validate keyboard, mobile, contrast, and reduced motion.
adaptations.slides: Preserve hierarchy and palette with native editable shapes and text. Replace motion with static emphasis.
adaptations.documents: Use native headings, readable body text, restrained callouts, and solid reading surfaces.
adaptations.images: Describe composition and material cues; check text and layout separately. Do not claim pixel-exact token fidelity.

prompt: Apply Synthwave to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. Bold system sans-serif headings with monospace labels. Horizon grid and sunset geometry behind a stable foreground. Deep violet, magenta outlines, and a warm stylized sun. Palette: background #180e32, surface #291b45, text #fff3ff, muted #d8bde7, accent #ffa9d9, border #956cad. Essential traits: Retro horizon grid; Pink-violet palette; Clean readable panels. Avoid: Flashing neon; Overloaded gradients; Low-contrast purple text. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
